how_to_request.value: submit a request on the Returns & Refunds page or contact Customer Service with your order number
how_to_request.quote: To request a price adjustment for an online order, submit a request on our Returns & Refunds page or contact Customer Service with your order number.

return_window_days.quote: Merchandise that is unworn, unwashed, and in new condition with original tags attached may be returned within 30 days of the purchase date for a refund to the original form of payment.

price_match_allowed.quote: If an item you purchased from Ridgeline Outfitters is offered by us at a lower price, a one-time price adjustment may be requested within 14 days after the purchase date.

price_match_window_days.quote: If an item you purchased from Ridgeline Outfitters is offered by us at a lower price, a one-time price adjustment may be requested within 14 days after the purchase date.

price_match_conditions.value: Only one price adjustment per item (one-time)
price_match_conditions.quote: If an item you purchased from Ridgeline Outfitters is offered by us at a lower price, a one-time price adjustment may be requested within 14 days after the purchase date.

price_match_conditions.value: Must be the identical item, in the same size and color, offered for sale by Ridgeline Outfitters
price_match_conditions.quote: Price adjustments apply only to the identical item, in the same size and color, offered for sale by Ridgeline Outfitters.

price_match_conditions.value: Item must not have been purchased with a promotion code or other discount, unless the only discount was free shipping
price_match_conditions.quote: Items purchased with a promotion code or other discount are not eligible for a price adjustment, unless the only discount used was free shipping.

price_match_conditions.value: Final Sale and clearance items are excluded
price_match_conditions.quote: Final Sale and clearance items are also excluded.

price_match_conditions.value: Lower price must not result from typographical errors, limited-quantity offers, or member-only promotions
price_match_conditions.quote: Lower prices resulting from typographical errors, limited-quantity offers, or member-only promotions are not eligible.

price_match_conditions.value: Order confirmation, receipt, or packing slip is required
price_match_conditions.quote: Your order confirmation, receipt, or packing slip is required.

manufacturer_warranty_months.quote: Ridgeline outerwear is warranted against defects in materials and workmanship for one year from the purchase date.
